# doc-lag

> Detect documentation made stale by a code change. Local-first CLI, GitHub Action, and read-only MCP server. Evidence-backed findings for developers, CI, and coding agents.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/doc-lag
GitHub: https://github.com/TarcisioPhilips/doc-lag
License: MIT

## Quick commands

```bash
npx doc-lag scan --base main
npx -y doc-lag mcp
npx -y -p doc-lag doc-lag-mcp
```

## Agent setup (copy-paste for coding agents)

Set up doc-lag in this repo following https://github.com/TarcisioPhilips/doc-lag/blob/main/docs/AGENT_SETUP.md

## Docs discovery

Default scan: root README/AGENTS/CLAUDE/CONTRIBUTING, `docs/**`, `website/docs/**`, `apps/docs/**`, `packages/*/README.md`, `content/**` — `.md` and `.mdx`. Config: `doc-lag.config.json` or `--docs-include` / `--docs-exclude`. Planned: OpenAPI/Swagger and reStructuredText support.

## Docs-sync (optional)

Off by default. Enable with `docsSync` in config, `--docs-sync`, Action `docs-sync`, MCP `docs_sync: true`, or `DOC_LAG_DOCS_SYNC=true`. Emits `docs.missing` for pairing rules and new Action inputs/outputs, package bins (exports opt-in), CLI flags/commands (commander/argparse/click), MCP tools, and (opt-in) env keys (`env.added`) or hand-rolled argv flags (`cli.argv`). Mentions include bold list items (`- **tool_name**`) as well as inline code/tables. Common English names (e.g. `archive`) need structured mentions (inline code, table cell, bold, or fenced YAML/`with:` key), not bare prose/headings. Large diffs: cat-file batching skips oversized blobs with a warning instead of crashing. Enforce with `--docs-sync-enforce` / Action `docs-sync-enforce` / MCP `docs_sync_enforce`. Skip with commit trailer `Docs-Not-Needed: <reason>` or Action label `no-docs-needed` (event payload; subscribe to `labeled`/`unlabeled`). Sticky comment / job summary show a Missing documentation section; Action output `docs-missing-count`; MCP `scan_diff` text adds Action items for the agent when `docs.missing` exists. Optional `--rank jev` never scores `docs.missing`. JSON Schema for config: `schema/doc-lag.config.schema.json`. This repository dogfoods docs-sync via root `doc-lag.config.json` with `enforce: false`.
